issue.body:
This test is incompatible with `-Dtests.iters` for a couple of reasons:

- The index name is derived from the test name which contains invalid
  characters if running with `-Dtests.iters`. Fixed in this commit by
  using a different index name.

- The test assumes that certain stats start out at zero, which is not
  the case if running multiple iterations of this test on the internal
  cluster. Fixed in this commit by setting `scope = TEST`.

Relates #99766
